title: poker: 7-card hand ranking evaluator
description: No hand ranking evaluator exists. GameDefinition.hand_rankings parses the ranking list (royal_flush..high_card) but nothing evaluates hands. Need a function best_hand(cards: list[ComponentData]) -> HandRank that selects the best 5-card combination from 7 cards (2 hole + 5 community) and returns an orderable rank. This can be pure Python in the engine or a WASM extension per the architecture. The showdown phase resolves 'best_hand(hand + community) wins pot'. Tests: test_best_hand_from_seven_cards in tests/test_poker.py.
